title: Stability of inverted perovskite solar cells: a focus on interface phenomena
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07642K, Review Article

The review offers a perspective on degradation in inverted PSCs, tracing the progression from intrinsic instabilities of interfacial materials to interface-amplified degradation in the perovskite absorber.
